summary: Implemented S03T02 by making oversized JSON spooling preserve full directive-aware envelopes in result files while returning a bounded preview that includes directive bundle metadata, required directive obligations, conflicts, deprecations, and missing-required counts.
command: pnpm exec tsc -b packages/core/tsconfig.json apps/cli/tsconfig.json --pretty false && pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/cli-agent-directives.test.ts && pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/cli.test.ts -t 'spools oversized json command output to a result file'
